title: Efficient reduced verifier
statement: Let $f$ be a polynomial-time computable map from bit strings to bit strings. Let $M$ map pairs of bit strings to a bit, and suppose the verifier returning $M(x,r)$ is efficient in the specified polynomial-time model. For any natural numbers $a,k$, there are natural numbers $a',k'$ such that the verifier returning $M(f(x),r')$, where $r'$ is the prefix of $r$ of length $a(|f(x)|+1)^k$, is efficient in that model, and $a(|f(x)|+1)^k\le a'(|x|+1)^{k'}$ for every bit string $x$.
hypotheses_covered: The verifier returning $M(x,r)$ is efficient in the specified polynomial-time model
$M$ is a map from pairs of bit strings to a bit
